metadata.description: Petroleum and chemical engineering skills for WVU PNGE undergraduates — 76 skills, 12 agents, and 12 commands split across 8 themed plugins. Covers Li/Mg recovery from produced waters, state oil-and-gas regulators, federal data agencies, literature and patent landscapes, completions and production engineering, water geochemistry and treatment, and ChBE engineering-science tutoring.

plugins.name: pnge-core
plugins.description: Flagship Li/Mg prospector agent, EIA + USGS produced waters/minerals, federated literature + DataCite DOI search, shared HTML visualizer, /doctor preflight. Install this first.

plugins.name: pnge-federal-data
plugins.description: Non-regulatory federal datasets: USGS (earthquakes, water, core center, National Map), NETL EDX + NATCARB, DOE geothermal, EPA Envirofacts/ECHO/GHGRP + Treatability, BOEM, BLM, FracFocus, NASA Earthdata, EJScreen/CEJST/SVI, WRI Aqueduct.

plugins.name: pnge-state-regulatory
plugins.description: State O&G regulators and cross-border discharge compliance: WV/PA/OH Appalachia stack, TX/NM/ND/LA/AR/OK/CA/CO commissions, Appalachian mineral parcels, and OSPAR offshore discharge standards. Adds regulatory-disposal-analyst agent + /regulatory-screen, /disposal-screen.

plugins.name: pnge-economics
plugins.description: Economic and trade data for TEA/LCA and energy geopolitics: FRED, BLS, BEA, Census, World Bank, UN Comtrade, IEA. Includes pnge-geopolitics and tea-lca-analyst agents + /well-economics, /tea-dle.

plugins.name: pnge-patents
plugins.description: USPTO / PatentsView DLE patent landscape: sorbent, membrane, electrochemical, solvent-extraction. Includes dle-patent-scout agent + /patent-landscape.

plugins.name: pnge-well-engineering
plugins.description: Completions + production wellwork as one workflow: frac design, wellbore stability, petrophysics, DFIT/minifrac, matrix acidizing, tubing/artificial lift/flow assurance, nodal analysis, RTA/DCA, well-test analysis, production chemistry, well-integrity, PVT, stage surveillance + KGS well-logs and Macrostrat stratigraphy references. Includes api-well-standards agent + /completions-design.

plugins.name: pnge-geochem-pw
plugins.description: Produced-water geochemistry and treatment: PHREEQC speciation + scaling, NIST thermodynamics, material/energy balance + Rachford-Rice flash, tNavigator-style reservoir-fluid tools. Includes water-chem-qaqc, lab-method-planner, and pnge-pw-treatment agents + /water-chem-compare.

plugins.name: pnge-engineering-science
plugins.description: ChBE and MAE engineering-science tutoring mapped to WVU courses: fluid mechanics (311), reaction engineering (321), thermodynamics + EOS (231), heat transfer, mass transfer/separations, aqueous chemistry + electrochemistry, materials/fracture mechanics. Includes pnge-tutor agent.
